headline: All 15 user-facing answers returned EMPTY. Two stacked defects, both production-code-identical.

defect_A.name: clean_reply discards the whole answer
defect_A.rule: re.search(r'\?\s*[A-Za-z]', block) with >15 chars after -> block classified fabricated Q&A turn; leading/early ? nukes the first block -> ''
defect_A.production_parity: cleanup byte-identical to modal_app.py/eval.py per its docstring
defect_A.gate_impact: 0/400 gate results empty and 0/400 start with ? -> Defect A did NOT contaminate 5a62c00; formal corpus does not trigger it

defect_B.name: model prepends question-echo + leading ? on plain-WhatsApp phrasing
defect_B.evidence: all 15 raw generations carry an early ? (e.g. p01 'sijafikia kiwango?...', p03 '...kama mwajiri?...', p02 bare '?')
defect_B.production_parity: orchestrator prompt uses tokenizer.apply_chat_template(add_generation_prompt=True), identical to modal_app.py -> not a harness priming artifact
defect_B.caveat: exercised the code-identical local orchestrator + Modal generate endpoint, not the production /answer HTTP path end-to-end

secondary_findings: Q13/Q14/Q16 fixes are phrasing-fragile: corrected facts NOT retrieved on these fresh plain phrasings (top-3 was irrelevant)
PAYE routing regression on plain phrasing (p02): unlabeled 'kodi ya serikali' + Swahili numeral routed fact and hallucinated
SDL rate confusion (p04): 0.5% quoted (WCF's rate; SDL is 3.5%)
Retrieval on colloquial register is broadly weak (several wholly-irrelevant top-3), masked downstream by Defect A
